retained_controls.label: Three new private owners, two public wrappers, exact Native command/validation/access and one derived store-picker function compile on the documented model
One external Native CREATE intent atomically prepares the explicit customer and saves the same original draft payload; it creates no posted sale fact
Exact replay reuses the complete external intent and creates no second customer, account, draft or Native apply
Same external request rejects changed invoice lines before another Native apply
Original Native draft validation failure rolls back the new customer, account and both request layers
A Native draft engine refusal after buyer preparation rolls back the entire owner transaction
An explicit customer that differs from the selected Mandor is refused atomically
Existing draft customer classification uses the immutable account UUID rather than the same visible Epi name
Native store eligibility filters explicit Mandor accounts before both pagination and global totals; an ordinary MD-like code remains a store
Current permission revocation refuses an already-committed external replay
Only authenticated executes the two narrow public wrappers; the internal read role receives only a membership predicate, never account-table or save access
A standalone buyer UUID cannot be repurposed as a different complete sales intent
The atomic draft wrapper cannot dispatch POST or any payment action

fresh_controls.label: An unchanged Native EDIT intent can switch an unposted draft to another explicitly selected same-name Mandor while retaining the sale identity

fixture_repair: Read the EDIT action review token for EDIT; the first thirteen controls and all private/Native function bodies remain unchanged.
